Torchlight Mine was an Arathi mine that has since fallen to the shadow in northeastern Hallowfall. The mouth of the Coldshadow Cave is at on the eastern wall. The area is bordered by Stillstone Pond to the southeast, the Hillhelm Stead of the greater Light's Blooming farm to the south, Isaec's Folly to the southwest, and the Faded Shore to the west and northwest.

After being defeated by an adventurer sent by Skitter, he runs away and is later encountered in Darkflame Cleft. He is presumably the leader of the Waxtail kobolds.

Tragically Deceased Crabs are dead crabs found at the Restless Wetlands on the Waking Shores. They are initially found inside the camp at . After completing Wildlife Rescue, the ones in the camp disappear and new ones are found just outside the camp at , getting eaten by Grateful Gulls. They are untargetable, but their name shows up in the tooltip when mousing over them.

After completing Wildlife Rescue, the ones in the camp disappear and new ones are found just outside the camp at , getting eaten by Grateful Basilisks. They are untargetable, but their name shows up in the tooltip when mousing over them.

Trapped Sea Turtles are sea turtles located at the Restless Wetlands in the Waking Shores. They are being tortured by Rampaging Winds. After being rescued, their name changes to 'Rescued Sea Turtle'.
Trapped Caretakers are kyrian located in the Firstborne's Bounty in Bastion.
Trapped Critter is obtained by using Empty Bait Cage on a critter. Use it at the Large Nest in the to summon Gharrik.
The Trap Card is a face down card played by Cutwater Card Sharks in Freehold in Tiragarde Sound.

The Tranquil Strand is located at the northern end of the southwestern peninsula on the Isle of Dorn. What's left of Dalaran fell here after the nerubian ambush at the start of the Isle of Dorn storyline in Violent Impact, beginning The War Within campaign properly. Following the arrival of the Horde and Alliance fleets, both factions established a camp here to train the earthen. The area is bordered by Dhar Oztan to the southwest and is across the bay from Storm's Watch and Dornogal.
Trangad is an earthen located in the Lapidarium in the Fissure in Dornogal. He is working on an Oathsworn Worker.
Transcendence: Linked Spirits is a monk class talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Escape from Reality.
Transpositional Anomalies are located just south of Gadgetzan in Tanaris.
Transformatory Drudge is a skitterling located in the Laboratory of the Grand Splicer in Azj-Kahet.
Transportation Carts are found in the Slitherdrake Roost in Zaralek Cavern.
Transcribed Kul Tiran Journal is a quest reward from Laid To Rest At Last.
Trapped Dryads are dryads located at the Barrows of Reverie in the Emerald Dream.

The Translocated Gorger is a devourer mount that is combined from 20x Devoured Energy-Pod that drops from the bosses of Devourer Swarms on K'aresh. Players can loot four energy pods per week across the warband. Use this macro to check which of the four swarm events have been looted: /run for k, v in pairs({ TheAtrium = 86464, Primus = 86447, Tazavesh = 86465, TheOasis = 84993}) do print(format("%s: %s", k, C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompletedOnAccount(v) and "\124cff00ff00Killed\124r" or "\124cffff0000Not Killed\124r")) end

Tranquilizing Dart can be obtained by looting Ve'nari's Package in Stormsong Valley after accepting the quest Such a Sleebee-head. It is also provided during Tranquila-Bee, Dubious Intent, What Does the Fox Dream?, and Dream-Dream-Dream-Dream-Dreameringeding!.
Translucent Wing is a trash item that can drop from various hostile moths in .
The Trampled Scavenger is a dead saurok found at the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder. Two Zandalari Potions can be found next to it.
Tranquility Bloom is an herb gathered in Eversong Woods, Zul'Aman, Harandar, and the Voidstorm.
Training Blocks are located in various vrykul settlements such as Skold-Ashil and Akstad in Stormheim. One is being used by Urgev the Flayer.
Traitor's Talon drops from Muro'jin and Nekraxx in Maisara Caverns.
Tranquillien Archer's Bow is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 80 Trader's Tender.
Tranquillien Archer's Quiver is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 100 Trader's Tender.

The Tranquil Repose runs along the former path of the Dead Scar in Eversong Woods. It begins from the Path of Dawn near the East Sanctum in the north, crosses the Elrendar River, and ends at the Ruins of Deatholme near the Thalassian Pass.
Traitorous Acolyte's Blade is a quest reward from The Traitors of Tranquillien.
Traitor Captain's Executioner is a quest reward from The Traitors of Tranquillien.
Training with Patience is a player vs. player achievement earned for winning a Training Grounds match in any of the listed maps without dying.

Transmute: Mote of Light is a transmutation with Midnight Alchemy to transform Motes of Primal Energy into Motes of Light. Unlocking the recipe at Camberon's Cauldron requires 3x Stabilized Derivate and 25x Artisan Alchemist's Moxie.

Transmute: Mote of Primal Energy is a transmutation with Midnight Alchemy to transform Motes of Pure Void into Motes of Primal Energy. Unlocking the recipe at Camberon's Cauldron requires 3x Stabilized Derivate and 25x Artisan Alchemist's Moxie.
